name: add_primitive_object
description: G-2: a Blank pipeline project (F-2) gets a shape without an asset. Add Object > Cube sends one spawn of engine://primitives/cube; the Outliner shows Cube and selects it, and the Inspector's model field reads the primitive. Add material pass... (G-1, Create missing targets) and present reading its output (F-6) put a grey box on screen; the pass is Deferred geometry, not Forward opaque, because the primitive's default material routes to deferred_geometry and nothing draws it in a forward pass until G-4. A second Cube is named Cube_001.
